title: Expose supported unregistered detached builds as owned background work in Sessions
outcome: Supported background builds that are not indexed launcher/test runs have authoritative owner and lifecycle evidence available to the Sessions busy projection, without inferring liveness from transcript history or adding a parallel lifecycle registry.
acceptance: An independently concurred design identifies which unregistered detached build executions have authoritative owner and liveness evidence, and explicitly documents unsupported cases and uncertainty.

For the supported executions, Sessions shows owned background work through start, active, completion and uncertainty transitions using the existing command/session ownership mechanism; tests cover owner vs notification recipient and foreground/background combinations without transcript-based liveness inference.
The final implementation satisfies the project's required independent review and validation before landing.
